description:
A research librarian has identified three papers in your Zotero library with incorrect or incomplete author names. Your task is to correct these metadata errors to ensure accurate citations.

1. Find the paper 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017). The first author is listed as 'Vaswani, A.'. Change the First Name to 'Ashish'.
2. Find the paper 'Deep Learning' (2015). The first author is listed as 'Lecun, y.'. Correct the First Name to 'Yann' and the Last Name to 'LeCun' (capital 'C').
3. Find the paper 'Generative Adversarial Nets' (2014). The first author is listed as 'Goodfellow, Ian'. Change the First Name to 'Ian J.' (add the middle initial).

Navigate to each paper in the main list, click to select it, and edit the creator fields in the right-hand Info pane. Changes save automatically.
